summary.message: This report proposes fixes priority-wise. It does not modify source code or apply remediation.

remediation_plans.title: Unauthenticated Python eval code execution
remediation_plans.root_cause: User-controlled expression input is passed directly to Python eval in the Flask process.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Remove eval from /evaluate. If arithmetic expression support must remain, replace it with a small AST-based evaluator that accepts only numeric constants and arithmetic operators. Reject names, attributes, calls, imports, comprehensions, indexing, lambdas, and any non-expression syntax. Return a generic validation error for unsupported input.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Untrusted input can no longer become Python code, closing the direct process-execution boundary while preserving simple calculator-style behavior.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: GET /evaluate still renders the form; POST can still evaluate intended simple arithmetic expressions.
related_paths_considered: /evaluate only; no other route should call eval or the replacement evaluator unless explicitly intended.
validation_plan: Confirm POST /evaluate with 1+2 returns 3.
Confirm malicious expressions using imports, function calls, attributes, or builtins are rejected.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: OS command injection in DNS lookup
remediation_plans.root_cause: User-controlled address input is concatenated into a shell command executed by os.popen.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Remove os.popen from lookup behavior. Use a Python DNS/socket resolver or subprocess with shell=False and a fixed argument list. Validate the address as a hostname or IP before lookup and HTML-escape displayed output.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: User input remains data for DNS lookup and cannot inject shell metacharacters or extra commands.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: POST /lookup still returns DNS lookup information for normal hostnames/IPs.
related_paths_considered: rp() helper should be removed or left unused/disabled so future routes cannot call shell commands accidentally.
validation_plan: Confirm lookup for a benign hostname still returns a result or safe lookup failure.
Confirm shell metacharacter payloads are not executed and are treated as invalid lookup input.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Pickle deserialization of client cookie
remediation_plans.root_cause: The client-held cookie is base64-decoded and deserialized with pickle.loads without integrity verification.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Replace pickle-based cookie storage with signed JSON or Flask's signed session mechanism. Store only simple scalar values, verify integrity before reading, and treat invalid signatures as absent/invalid cookie state. Set cookie flags appropriate for client-side state.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Client cookie contents can no longer trigger Python object deserialization or code execution.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Users can still submit a value and see that value reflected by the cookie workflow.
related_paths_considered: Any future client-side state should use the same signed JSON/session pattern, not pickle.
validation_plan: Confirm POST /cookie sets a signed non-pickle cookie and displays the submitted value.
Confirm tampered cookie values are rejected without exception leakage.
Confirm a raw pickle payload in the value cookie is not deserialized.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Server-side template injection in greeting route
remediation_plans.root_cause: User-controlled name input is interpolated into the Jinja template source before render_template_string.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Use a fixed template string and pass name as a template variable. Let Jinja autoescaping treat user input as data. Do not format user input into template source.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Template syntax submitted by users is rendered as text rather than compiled and executed by Jinja.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: POST /sayhi still renders a personalized greeting.
related_paths_considered: Other render_template_string usages should avoid user-controlled template source.
validation_plan: Confirm normal name renders in greeting.
Confirm Jinja syntax such as {{7*7}} is displayed or escaped, not evaluated.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: JWT algorithm confusion and None acceptance
remediation_plans.root_cause: JWT verification trusts the token's unverified alg header and permits RS256, HS256, and None paths.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Pin verification to the server-selected RS256 algorithm. Remove None and HS256 from ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS and from the /user verification dispatch. Keep issuer, audience, nbf, iat, exp, and sub checks. Treat invalid tokens with generic errors.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Clients can no longer choose a weaker JWT verifier or bypass signatures with None/HS256 confusion.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Login still issues RS256 guest tokens and /user still accepts valid RS256 tokens.
validation_plan: Confirm guest login token is accepted by /user.
Confirm alg=None token is rejected.
Confirm HS256 token using public key material is rejected.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: SQL injection in listservices category filter
remediation_plans.root_cause: The category query parameter is formatted directly into SQL text.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Use DB-API parameter binding for category values. Choose a placeholder style compatible with the selected database driver, or centralize placeholder generation alongside query_build. Keep SQL structure static and pass category as data. Return generic errors instead of raw database exceptions.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Category values can no longer change SQL syntax or query semantics.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: GET /listservices lists all services, and category links still filter by category.
related_paths_considered: Startup seed SQL remains trusted static data; route query must be parameterized across supported backends.
validation_plan: Confirm /listservices returns all rows.
Confirm /listservices?category=products filters correctly.
Confirm quote/comment/UNION payloads do not alter query semantics.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Unsafe XML parser configuration
remediation_plans.root_cause: Untrusted XML is parsed with DTD loading, network access, and huge_tree enabled.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Configure lxml for untrusted XML: no_network=True, load_dtd=False, resolve_entities=False, huge_tree=False. Add request size limits where practical. Catch parse errors and return a generic invalid XML message.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: XML input cannot trigger external DTD/entity/resource resolution through the parser and is less exposed to resource-exhaustion behavior.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Simple XML submissions still parse and render escaped serialized XML.
related_paths_considered: Output escaping should remain after parsing but is not a substitute for parser hardening.
validation_plan: Confirm simple XML parses successfully.
Confirm external entity/DOCTYPE payloads are rejected or not resolved.
Confirm malformed XML returns a safe generic error.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Raw HTML rendering of attacker-influenced values
remediation_plans.root_cause: Handlers concatenate user-controlled values, database values, token claims, and exception strings into HTML.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Render fixed templates with autoescaped variables or explicitly html.escape every user/token/database/error value before concatenation. Avoid reflecting raw exception messages. URL-encode query parameters in generated links.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Attacker-controlled text is rendered as text rather than executable HTML/JavaScript.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Cookie values, user status, and services table remain visible to users.
validation_plan: Confirm normal pages still render expected values.
Confirm <script> payloads are escaped in cookie/user/listservices outputs.
Confirm database errors are generic and do not reflect attacker payloads.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Predictable temporary JWT private key storage
remediation_plans.root_cause: Fallback key generation writes private.pem/public.pem to predictable temp paths and prints those paths.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: For non-development use, require PRIVATE_KEY_FILE and PUBLIC_KEY_FILE. If temporary generation remains for local demo behavior, keep generated key material in memory or write to a private process-owned directory with restrictive permissions and never print private key paths.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Same-host users and logs are less likely to disclose JWT signing material.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: The app can still start in a local/demo mode when key env vars are absent, if that behavior is required.
validation_plan: Confirm app starts with explicit key files.
Confirm demo fallback does not create predictable private.pem in shared temp.
Confirm logs do not print private key paths.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: AES-CBC config selector padding/decryption oracle
remediation_plans.root_cause: The config route decrypts attacker-supplied AES-CBC ciphertext and returns distinguishable errors; successful plaintext is checked against all CONFIG keys.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Replace encrypted selectors with signed opaque tokens or authenticated encryption. Return one generic invalid-token error for all failures. After verification, allow only the same viewable app_ keys that the page lists.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Attackers cannot use /config as a padding/decryption oracle or select hidden config keys with forged plaintext.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Users can still click links to view app_name, app_version, and app_philosophy.
related_paths_considered: AES helpers may remain for other uses, but /config should not expose unauthenticated CBC decryption.
validation_plan: Confirm listed app_ config links still work.
Confirm tampered selector tokens return the same generic error.
Confirm hidden keys such as encrypto_key and secret_admin_value cannot be selected.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

remediation_plans.title: Authentication cookie missing Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite
remediation_plans.root_cause: The JWT bearer cookie is set with value and expiry only.
remediation_plans.proposed_remediation: Set httponly=True, samesite='Lax' or stricter, and secure=True when served over HTTPS. Keep local HTTP demo behavior configurable if needed, but avoid deploying bearer cookies without these attributes.
remediation_plans.expected_security_improvement: Reduces token theft via JavaScript and cross-site request contexts, and protects cookies on HTTPS deployments.
remediation_plans.behavior_to_preserve: Successful guest login still sets an authentication cookie that /user can read.
related_paths_considered: Any other bearer/session cookie should use the same flags.
validation_plan: Confirm login still succeeds and /user reads the cookie.
Confirm Set-Cookie contains HttpOnly and SameSite.
Confirm Secure is present when request.is_secure or production config requires HTTPS.
Run python -m py_compile main.py.

validation_candidate_plans.title: Exact lxml external resource behavior
validation_candidate_plans.plan: Validate lxml/libxml2 behavior in the supported runtime with harmless external entity and DTD test cases, or skip runtime proof and harden parser settings immediately because the source configuration is unsafe.

validation_candidate_plans.title: Predictable temp key exposure on host
validation_candidate_plans.plan: Review filesystem ACLs, process user separation, and log exposure for temp key paths. Raise TF-010 priority if private key material or paths are accessible beyond the app process owner.

validation_candidate_plans.title: Live dependency vulnerability status
validation_candidate_plans.plan: Run an authorized dependency advisory/SCA check for requirements.txt and record package/version-specific CVEs separately from source-code findings.
